valid_until: Content authority, selected owner/sense, policy, feature contracts or scope changes; full step1 planned-form screening can revise this head-only selection.
scope: One offline next-work sub-step after V1.34 handoff/consolidation. No new worktree, baseline, candidate pool, word approval, web research or integration.
owner_authority: Owner-adopted continuous source-only loop of2026-10-18; research and reviewed handoffs only. Integration/landing remain separately authorized.

priority_decision.rationale: Existing884pending packages cover many familiar heads:368offline exploratory queries leave91exact-head hypotheses before cross-spelling/selected-sense checks. A concrete remaining gap exists in common garden/animal, lighting, measuring/working, clothing and paper vocabulary. Forty provisional families are selected without admitting forms, inventing edges or adding technical/botanical tails to pad size. Three apparent animal gaps actually preserve older holds; light-switch input keeps its actual existing owner.
priority_decision.backlog_extension: Root-authored familiar/school/home/culture hypotheses extend the historical backlog. Cached frequency is positive support only; no claim of exhaustive Romanian vocabulary coverage.
priority_decision.existing_stock_priority: The62-family/101-key matching-lemma morphology lane remains the narrower potential integration/curation priority. This source tick does not re-research or install it; substantial concrete uncovered vocabulary still warrants bounded discovery.

method: Compose immutable canonical records/form payloads once, then read15additional exact-ref legacy final pool bytes for record-head/proposed-family attention. Do not reuse only the old V1.34 query matches.

Reserve only accepted/unlanded source-approved final payload. Current serving owners are their own lane. Integrated historical and inactive/observed/planned forms remain attention, not new reservations or approvals.
Compare head normalization/index/labels/aliases, discovery concepts/snapshots, current Cald proxies, raw/current deferred sets and actual ReviewedUnresolved literals under unchanged authority bytes.

Manual selected-sense checks catch alternate spelling and qualified-expression attempts to reopen Greier/Țestoasă/Calmar. Proper band versus vine ambiguity remains deferred; plant versus fruit distinctions are explicit hypotheses.
Missing exact heads do not prove new meanings, full-paradigm availability, source truth, graph floors or target quality. Full step1 screening must precede every later web call.
